Casting your Super Ability grants allies within ? meters of you <strand/>Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

Destroying a <strand/>Tangle releases three 10 meter radius pulses from where it was destroyed; one pulse every 2 seconds. Allies within this radius are healed for 15 HP and receive <strand/>Woven Mail for 10 seconds. 

While <strand/>Woven Mail is active, gain <pve 300% /> <pvp [200%] /> Increased Base Melee Regeneration Speed.
